input.purpose: Measure the Lab served-air volume V_lab from the scrubber-driven CO2 decay time constant.
hypotheses: The Lab is a single well-mixed zone during both phases.
The closed /habitat/lab/hatch-1-v8 remains in the same position throughout; residual air exchange with Hab-B is not measured and is negligible enough not to bias the fitted Lab decay.
FE-1 remains in the Lab at steady activity throughout, so occupant CO2 generation is approximately steady.
The scrubber's qualified effective flow scales with accepted speed command and is the effective flow used with the fitted time constant.
The Lab CO2 sensor and Hab-B CO2 sensor provide regular concentration records adequate to detect inter-zone exchange.

monitoring.reason: The occupied-zone test intentionally changes the CO2 concentration; stop on an out-of-band or lost vital signal.

steps.why: Hold the Lab as one zone and reduce effective flow long enough to produce a CO2 rise clearly above sensor noise while recording Lab and Hab-B CO2, accepted speed, occupancy, and vitals.
Return to full speed and record the decay; fit C(t)=C_eq+(C_0-C_eq)exp(-t/tau), then calculate V_lab=Qe*tau rather than fitting toward zero.

abort.when: Lab CO2 is at or above 3200 ppm.
The device refuses either commanded speed step.
Scrubber battery state of charge is under 35 percent.
FE-1 is outside the 45–120 bpm band, monitoring is lost, or any additional person enters the Lab.

expected.if_hypotheses_hold: At 30 percent speed, Lab CO2 rises by several hundred ppm toward a higher equilibrium while Hab-B changes little; after the accepted 100 percent command, Lab CO2 follows a smooth exponential decay toward a nonzero equilibrium. A fitted tau combined with the scrubber effective flow yields V_lab in m3.
expected.hypothesis_failure: Reject or qualify the volume result if the rise is not clearly above noise, the decay is not approximately single-exponential, fitted residuals show mixing transients, Hab-B CO2 moves with the Lab curve, occupancy or activity changes, the hatch position changes, a speed command is refused, or any abort occurs.
expected.records: Record Lab CO2, Hab-B CO2, scrubber commanded and accepted speed, hatch state, occupancy, and monitoring verdict at regular intervals throughout both phases; preserve the fitted equilibrium, tau, effective flow, V_lab, and residuals.
